headline: Claude Fable 5.1 Solves 370-year-old Cyphral Distich Cipher
summary: An AI model cracked a centuries-old cryptographic puzzle that had stumped human experts for decades, revealing a hidden message.
details: Claude Fable 5.1 has successfully deciphered the Cyphral Distich, a complex cryptogram left by Sir Thomas Urquhart, which had remained unsolved for over 370 years. The AI model achieved this feat in 44 minutes, processing 176,000 tokens.

The Cyphral Distich, consisting of two lines of 64 numbers, was published in Urquhart's Logopandecteision and had resisted numerous attempts at decryption since its creation. It was even listed among the top 50 unsolved encrypted messages by historical-cipher researcher Klaus Schmeh.

Previous attempts by cryptographers focused on external keys and methods like frequency analysis and substitution, all of which proved unsuccessful. The breakthrough came when Fable 5.1 realized the key was embedded within the text itself, specifically related to Urquhart's 32 "Proquiritations."

The solution involved using the number at each position in the cryptogram to index a word within the corresponding Proquiritation, with the first letter of that word forming the plaintext. This revealed a hidden prayer for King Charles II, aligning with Urquhart's known Royalist sympathies.

Fable 5.1 also deciphered a second, larger cryptogram by Urquhart, the Cyphral Octastich, demonstrating its advanced capabilities in historical cryptography. The AI was guided to focus on problems that were verifiable but not overly complex, avoiding those that had stumped major organizations.

The success highlights the growing potential of advanced AI models in solving complex historical and mathematical challenges. The prompt engineer noted that while the clue was simple, Fable 5.1's ability to recognize and apply it was key.

headline: Larry Ellison cancels $7.5 billion Oracle stock sale
summary: Oracle's co-founder and executive chairman has backed out of selling 50 million shares, a move that would have netted him billions.
details: Oracle co-founder and executive chairman Larry Ellison has canceled a planned sale of his Oracle stock, the company announced on Saturday.
Previously, Oracle had disclosed in a regulatory filing that Ellison planned to sell 50 million shares worth around $7.5 billion. The company did not offer a reason for the change in plans.
"No Oracle stock was sold under that plan, and he has no other plans to sell any of his Oracle stock," the company stated.
Oracle stock is currently down 22% since the beginning of the year. The company has been spending heavily on data centers and recently became a major security partner for TikTok’s U.S. operations.
caption:
Larry Ellison abandons $7.5 billion stock sale plan.

Oracle co-founder and executive chairman Larry Ellison has canceled a planned sale of his Oracle stock, the company announced on Saturday.

Previously, Oracle had disclosed in a regulatory filing that Ellison planned to sell 50 million shares worth around $7.5 billion. The company did not offer a reason for the change in plans.

"No Oracle stock was sold under that plan, and he has no other plans to sell any of his Oracle stock," the company stated.

Oracle stock is currently down 22% since the beginning of the year. The company has been spending heavily on data centers and recently became a major security partner for TikTok’s U.S. operations.
